NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Design Review No. DR-2012-01 & Use Permit No. UP-2013-02 Applicant: City of Azusa
Location: 213 E. Foothill Boulevard
A request for approval of a Design Review and Use Permit to allow the construction and use of an Intermodal Parking Facility, and review of the associated Draft Environmental Impact Report. The Draft EIR was revised to include an additional alternative, "Alternative 2", to the proposed project. The findings from the previous EIR on the build alternative, now known as "Alternative 1", have not changed and have been included as part of the draft EIR to allow for a meaningful comparison of alternatives.
